kinds.contract: How a job script must be written and what the worker checks
kinds.example: Complete, tested job script (see `example` file); start from these
kinds.pitfall: Known limitation or common mistake with the fix

entries.title: Job script contract (doc + result_obj)
entries.summary: FreeCAD Python runs headless in a sandbox. Pre-bound globals: App/FreeCAD, Part, Sketcher, params (dict from request.parameters), cadkit (tested helper library - prefer it). The script MUST define `doc` (App.newDocument(...)) and `result_obj` (final document object whose .Shape is the part, e.g. a PartDesign::Body; a bare Part.Shape is wrapped into a Part::Feature 'Result'). The runner recomputes doc, reports features in error, exports, then re-imports the files in a fresh process to validate.
entries.signature: globals: App, FreeCAD, Part, Sketcher, params: dict[str, float|str|bool]  ->  must set doc, result_obj
limitations: No FreeCADGui: no views, screenshots, selection or Gui.* calls.
No network, no subprocess/fork, no files outside the job directory; import only modules shipped with FreeCAD/Python.
Do not call doc.saveAs/exportStep yourself; the runner exports to deterministic names (model.FCStd/.step/.stl).
Write geometry in millimetres; FreeCAD's internal unit is mm.

entries.title: Validation spec (request.validation)
entries.summary: Checks run against the re-imported STEP (FCStd if no STEP). Fields: requireValidShape (default true), requireSolid (true), expectedBoundingBoxMm [x,y,z] extents, toleranceMm (0.01), expectedVolumeMm3 + volumeTolerancePct (0.5), expectedSolidCount, holes[{diameterMm, centersMm[[a,b]], axis 'z', reference 'bboxMin'|'origin', through true}], expectedHoleCount, requireParametric (FCStd must contain constrained sketches/expressions, not a baked shape), reportHoles. Each check returns {name, passed, expected, actual, message}. Engineering: material (aluminum_6061|steel|stainless_304|brass|copper|titanium|abs|pla|petg|nylon|polycarbonate|acetal) -> massProperties {massG, centerOfMassMm}; maxMassG; requireFullyConstrained (every sketch DoF 0); flexTests[{name?, set:{alias: value}, expect?:{boundingBoxMm, volumeMm3, holeCount}}] re-open the saved FCStd, change Params spreadsheet aliases, recompute and re-check (needs FCStd output). Add 'PNG' to outputs for a rendered 4-view preview with dimensions.
entries.signature: validation: { requireValidShape?, requireSolid?, expectedBoundingBoxMm?, toleranceMm?, expectedVolumeMm3?, volumeTolerancePct?, expectedSolidCount?, holes?, expectedHoleCount?, requireParametric?, reportHoles? }
limitations: A passing validation proves geometry facts, not that the design meets every user requirement; encode every stated dimension as a check.
Hole detection finds cylindrical, concave faces parallel to the given axis; countersinks/threads are not modelled.
Hole centres default to coordinates from the bounding-box minimum corner (reference 'bboxMin').

entries.title: Job error codes and how to repair
entries.summary: SCRIPT_SYNTAX_ERROR (fix line), SCRIPT_ERROR (traceback with job-script frames only), SCRIPT_CONTRACT (define doc/result_obj), RECOMPUTE_ERROR (featureErrors lists the failing feature + FreeCAD status message, e.g. sketch conflicting constraints with their indices), EXPORT_FAILED, VALIDATION_FAILED (compare checks[].expected vs actual), TIMEOUT, WORKER_CRASHED (OCCT fault: simplify booleans/fillets), SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE (server problem).
limitations: Sketcher conflict messages number constraints from 1 in the GUI convention; addConstraint returns 0-based indices.

entries.title: Parametric mounting plate with 4 through holes (PartDesign + Spreadsheet)
entries.summary: 120x80x10 plate, four 6.6 mm (M6 clearance) holes 12 mm from edges. Spreadsheet aliases drive named sketch constraints and the pad length, so the FCStd stays editable. Parameters: length, width, thickness, holeDiameter, edgeOffset.
limitations: Clearance diameters (ISO 273 medium): M3 3.4, M4 4.5, M5 5.5, M6 6.6, M8 9.0, M10 11.0, M12 13.5.

entries.title: Round flange with bolt-circle holes (PolarPattern)
entries.summary: Pad of two concentric circles (inner circle becomes the bore), one bolt-hole pocket on the pitch circle, then PartDesign::PolarPattern about the body's Z axis. Parameters: outerDiameter, thickness, boreDiameter, pcd, holeDiameter, holes.
limitations: Set body.Tip to the pattern so the Body shape includes it.

entries.title: Stepped shaft by Revolution + end Chamfer
entries.summary: Closed half-profile sketched on the XZ plane, revolved 360 degrees about the sketch H_Axis, then a PartDesign::Chamfer on the circular edge selected by geometry. Parameters: d1, l1, d2, l2, chamfer.
limitations: The profile must not cross the revolution axis.

entries.title: L-bracket with inner-corner Fillet (edge picked by geometry)
entries.summary: L profile on XZ plane padded along +Y (Reversed=True), then PartDesign::Fillet on the edge found by its bounding box rather than a hard-coded EdgeN. Parameters: leg, thickness, width, filletRadius.

entries.title: Part primitives + boolean Cut (parametric document objects)
entries.summary: Part::Box minus Part::Cylinder via Part::Cut; expressions keep the bore centred. Tool overshoots both faces to avoid coplanar booleans. Parameters: length, width, height, boreDiameter.

entries.title: Direct Part shape API: makeBox, makeFillet, cut, removeSplitter
entries.summary: Fast scripted geometry with Part.make* and TopoShape methods; result_obj may be a bare Part.Shape. Produces a baked (non-editable) FCStd.
limitations: Fails validation.requireParametric by design; use PartDesign or Part document objects when editability matters.

entries.title: Part.make* primitive constructors
entries.summary: Return Part.Shape (TopoShape), not document objects.
entries.signature: Part.makeBox(l, w, h, pnt=Vector(), dir=Vector(0,0,1)); Part.makeCylinder(r, h, pnt=Vector(), dir=Vector(0,0,1), angle=360); Part.makeSphere(r, pnt=Vector()); Part.makeCone(r1, r2, h, pnt, dir); Part.makeTorus(r1, r2, pnt, dir); Part.makePolygon([Vector,...], closed=False); Part.makeCircle(r, center, normal)

entries.title: TopoShape booleans, fillets, extrude, transforms
entries.summary: Methods on Part.Shape; most return new shapes (translate/rotate mutate in place; use .copy() first or .translated()).
entries.signature: s.fuse(other|[others]); s.cut(tool); s.common(tool); s.makeFillet(radius, edges); s.makeChamfer(size, edges); face.extrude(Vector); s.revolve(base, axis, angle); s.translated(Vector); s.rotated(center, axis, deg); s.mirror(base, normal); s.removeSplitter(); Part.Face(Part.Wire(edges)); Part.Wire(edges).isClosed()
limitations: Booleans with coplanar/tangent faces are fragile: overshoot tools by >=1 mm.
Call removeSplitter() after fuses to merge coplanar faces.

entries.title: Part workbench document objects (parametric)
entries.summary: doc.addObject('Part::Box','Name') etc. Booleans: obj.Base/obj.Tool (Cut), obj.Shapes=[...] (MultiFuse/MultiCommon). Extrusion: ext.Base=sketch; ext.Dir=Vector; ext.LengthFwd; ext.Solid=True. Revolution: rev.Source=sketch; rev.Axis; rev.Base; rev.Angle; rev.Solid=True.
entries.signature: box.Length/Width/Height; cyl.Radius/Height/Angle; obj.Placement = App.Placement(App.Vector(x,y,z), App.Rotation(App.Vector(0,0,1), deg))

entries.title: Sketch geometry: addGeometry with Part.LineSegment / Circle / ArcOfCircle
entries.summary: sk.addGeometry(geo, construction=False) returns the 0-based geometry index. Points of a geometry: 1=start, 2=end, 3=centre. Special ids: -1 = H_Axis (point 1 = origin), -2 = V_Axis. Sketch coordinates are local 2D (z=0).
entries.signature: sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(App.Vector(x0,y0,0), App.Vector(x1,y1,0)), False); sk.addGeometry(Part.Circle(App.Vector(cx,cy,0), App.Vector(0,0,1), r), False); sk.addGeometry(Part.ArcOfCircle(Part.Circle(c, App.Vector(0,0,1), r), a0_rad, a1_rad), False)
limitations: Profiles must be closed and non-self-intersecting to Pad/Pocket; nested closed wires make holes.

entries.title: Sketcher.Constraint types, named constraints and expressions
entries.summary: Constraint('Coincident', g1, p1, g2, p2); ('Horizontal'|'Vertical', g); ('DistanceX'|'DistanceY', g1, p1, g2, p2, value) (signed: p2 - p1); ('Distance', g, value); ('Radius'|'Diameter', g, value); ('Equal', g1, g2); ('PointOnObject', g, p, g_target); ('Tangent', g1, g2); ('Symmetric', g1, p1, g2, p2, g_line); ('Angle', g, rad). addConstraint returns a 0-based index (or list). Name it with sk.renameConstraint(i, 'Width') and drive it with sk.setExpression('.Constraints.Width', 'Params.width').
limitations: Do not add a DistanceX/Y between endpoints of a line already constrained Vertical/Horizontal (zero distance -> conflict).
Redundant/conflicting constraints mark the sketch Invalid; the error message lists offending constraints.

entries.title: Attaching sketches to planes/faces (AttachmentSupport, MapMode)
entries.summary: In a Body: plane = next(f for f in body.Origin.OriginFeatures if f.Role == 'XY_Plane'); sk.AttachmentSupport = [(plane, '')]; sk.MapMode = 'FlatFace'. Offset with sk.AttachmentOffset = App.Placement(App.Vector(0,0,z), App.Rotation()). On a feature face: [(pad, 'Face6')] (fragile; prefer origin planes + offsets).
limitations: FreeCAD 0.21 used `Support`; 1.x renamed it to `AttachmentSupport`.
Origin feature names are not stable across versions; select by .Role, not by name.
XZ_Plane normal is -Y: pads go toward -Y unless Reversed=True.

entries.title: PartDesign::Body and feature creation
entries.summary: body = doc.addObject('PartDesign::Body','Body'); create features with body.newObject(type, name) so they join the body and become the Tip. body.Shape is the Tip's shape. Use result_obj = body.
limitations: A Body must stay a single contiguous solid; disjoint pads fail.
Features added with doc.addObject (not body.newObject) are not in the body.

entries.title: PartDesign Pad and Pocket
entries.summary: pad.Profile = sketch; pad.Length = mm; pad.Type = 'Length'|'TwoLengths'|'UpToLast'|'UpToFirst'|'UpToFace'; pad.Midplane; pad.Reversed. Pocket: same plus Type 'ThroughAll'. For a through hole from a sketch on the XY plane use Type='ThroughAll' with Midplane=True.
limitations: A Pocket cuts opposite to the sketch normal; with a sketch on the bottom face it removes nothing unless Reversed/Midplane.

entries.title: PartDesign Revolution / Groove
entries.summary: rev.Profile = sketch; rev.ReferenceAxis = (sketch, ['H_Axis'|'V_Axis']) or (origin_axis, ['']); rev.Angle = 360. Groove removes material the same way.

entries.title: PartDesign Fillet / Chamfer / Draft / Thickness (dress-up features)
entries.summary: fil.Base = (feature, ['Edge3', 'Edge7']); fil.Radius = r. ch.Base = (feature, [...]); ch.Size = s. Thickness: th.Base = (feature, ['Face6']); th.Value; th.Mode. Choose edges by geometry: [f'Edge{i+1}' for i,e in enumerate(feature.Shape.Edges) if <test on e.BoundBox / e.Curve>].
limitations: Edge/face numbers change when upstream features change (topological naming); select by geometry in-script.
A fillet radius >= adjacent face width makes OCCT fail (RECOMPUTE_ERROR).

entries.title: PartDesign LinearPattern / PolarPattern / Mirrored
entries.summary: pat.Originals = [feature]; Linear: pat.Direction = (sketch, ['H_Axis']) or (origin_axis, ['']); pat.Length = total span; pat.Occurrences = n. Polar: pat.Axis = (z_axis, ['']); pat.Angle = 360; pat.Occurrences = n. Mirrored: pat.MirrorPlane = (plane, ['']). Set body.Tip = pat if needed.
limitations: Origin axes: next(f for f in body.Origin.OriginFeatures if f.Role == 'Z_Axis').

entries.title: Spreadsheet-driven parameters and expressions
entries.summary: sheet = doc.addObject('Spreadsheet::Sheet','Params'); sheet.set('B1','120 mm'); sheet.setAlias('B1','length'); doc.recompute(). Then obj.setExpression('Length','Params.length') or sketch.setExpression('.Constraints.Width','Params.width'). Expressions may use arithmetic: 'Params.length - Params.edgeOffset'.
limitations: Recompute the sheet before reading aliases.
Aliases must be valid identifiers and not look like cell names (e.g. 'L1' is invalid).

entries.title: Document, recompute and feature status
entries.summary: doc = App.newDocument('Name'); doc.recompute(); a feature in error has 'Invalid' in obj.State and obj.getStatusString() explains why. App.Vector(x,y,z); App.Rotation(axis, degrees); App.Placement(base, rotation).
limitations: Reading feature.Shape before doc.recompute() returns stale or null geometry.

entries.title: Hard-coded Edge/Face numbers break (topological naming)
entries.summary: Never hard-code 'Edge12'. Recompute, then select sub-elements by geometry (BoundBox, Curve type, centre, normal) and pass the computed names. Prefer attaching sketches to origin planes with AttachmentOffset over attaching to faces.

entries.title: Coplanar / tangent boolean faces produce invalid shapes
entries.summary: Make cutting tools overshoot the target by >=1 mm on faces that would otherwise coincide; fuse overlapping (not just touching) solids; call removeSplitter()/Refine=True afterwards. Check validation shape.isValid.

entries.title: Headless execution: no GUI, view providers or screenshots
entries.summary: Jobs run without FreeCADGui: obj.ViewObject is None, Gui.* is unavailable. Setting obj.Visibility is fine. Ask for numbers (geometry, checks, detected holes) instead of pictures.

entries.title: FreeCAD 0.21 vs 1.x API differences
entries.summary: Runtime is FreeCAD 1.1.3. Sketch/feature `Support` -> `AttachmentSupport` (1.0). Origin features: select by .Role ('XY_Plane', 'Z_Axis'), names carry suffixes. Toponaming mitigation in 1.0 does not make hard-coded EdgeN safe in scripts.

entries.title: cadkit.Model - parametric PartDesign in a few lines (preferred)
entries.summary: m = cadkit.Model(name, unitless=(), **params) creates doc + Params spreadsheet (aliases) + PartDesign Body; request.parameters override defaults. Values everywhere are numbers (mm) or expression strings over parameter names ('length - edge', 'hole/2'); expressions become FreeCAD expressions so the FCStd stays editable (bare numbers in +/- get mm). m.sketch(name, plane='XY'|'XZ'|'YZ', offset=0) -> Sketch; m.pad(s, length, reversed=False, symmetric=False); m.pocket(s, depth='through'|value); m.revolve(s, angle=360, axis='H'|'V', groove=False); m.fillet(select, r) / m.chamfer(select, size) where select is ['EdgeN'] or callable(shape)->names; m.polar_pattern(feature, count, angle=360, axis='Z'); m.linear_pattern(feature, length, count, direction='X'); m.mirror(feature, plane='YZ'); doc, result_obj = m.finish() (raises with the failing feature's message).
limitations: Fillet/chamfer reference edges by name and can break when parameters change (topological naming); prefer Sketch.rounded_rect and verify with validation.flexTests.

entries.title: cadkit.Sketch - fully constrained sketch primitives
entries.summary: Every primitive is fully constrained (DoF 0) and pinned to the sketch origin. s.rect(x, y, w, h, center=False, label=None); s.rounded_rect(x, y, w, h, r, center=False) (corner radii in the sketch - robust under flex tests); s.circle(cx, cy, d) (diameter!); s.polygon([(x, y), ...]) (each vertex pinned); s.slot(x1, y1, x2, y2, width). label names the driving constraints (e.g. 'PlateW').

entries.title: cadkit fastener standards and selectors
entries.summary: cadkit.clearance('M6', fit='fine'|'medium'|'coarse') -> 6.6 (ISO 273); cadkit.tap_drill('M6') -> 5.0; cadkit.counterbore('M6') -> (11.0, 6.4) for ISO 4762 SHCS. cadkit.edges(shape, kind='line'|'circle', parallel='X'|'Y'|'Z', at={'z': v}, radius=r) and cadkit.faces(shape, normal='+Z', at={...}) return 'EdgeN'/'FaceN' names chosen by geometry. cadkit.rect_pattern(x0, y0, dx, dy, nx, ny), cadkit.polar_points(radius, count, start_deg=0) return (x, y) lists.

entries.title: Mounting plate in 10 lines with cadkit (rounded corners, M6 clearance holes)
entries.summary: Same plate as example.partdesign.mounting_plate plus 3 mm sketch-level corner radii: fully constrained, spreadsheet-driven, passes flexTests. Parameters: length, width, thickness, hole, edge, corner.

entries.title: Enclosure lid: centred plate, counterbored M3 holes, slot, chamfer (cadkit)
entries.summary: Centred rectangle pad, through holes + counterbore pockets from a sketch offset to the top plane, a stadium slot, chamfered top edges selected by geometry.

entries.title: Model builds once but breaks when a parameter changes
entries.summary: Dress-up features (Fillet/Chamfer) and face-attached sketches store sub-element names that shift when dimensions change. Prove robustness with validation.flexTests; fix by moving rounds into sketches (cadkit rounded_rect), attaching sketches to origin planes with offsets, and binding every dimension to the Params spreadsheet.

entries.title: Rendered preview (PNG) - let the model see the part
entries.summary: Add 'PNG' to outputs: the verify phase renders preview.png headlessly (no GUI): iso/top/front/right at one shared scale, hidden-line removal, overall dimensions and a bbox/volume caption. In Code Mode return cad.preview(jobId) to receive it as image content. Needs 'STEP' or 'FCStd' in outputs too.
